description_en: Changes the network type of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb modify-db-instance-network-type --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --instance-network-type VPC --vpc-id vpc-bp19ame5m1r3oejns0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1cpq8mr64paltkb0000 --private-ip-address 10.10.XX.XX --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceNetworkType

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.
